import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for brands
brand_colors = {'Leica': '#E41A1C', 'Fuji': '#377EB8', 'Pentax': '#4DAF4A', 'Olympus': '#984EA3'}

# 1. Price vs Megapixels (scatter plot)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], s=150, label=brand, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price (scatter with sensor type)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sensor_markers = {'Micro 4/3': 'o', 'APS-C': 's', 'Full Frame': '^', 'Medium Format': 'D'}
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    ax2.scatter(row['weight_grams'], row['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[row['brand']], s=150, 
                marker=sensor_markers[row['sensor_type']], edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Weight vs Price', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Bar chart - Price by Brand
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = [brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index]
bars = ax3.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Price by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, brand_prices.values):
    ax3.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=10)

# 4. Body Type Distribution (pie chart)
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(body_counts)))
ax4.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, explode=[0.05]*len(body_counts), shadow=True)
ax4.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Sensor Type vs Megapixels (bar chart)
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
sensor_mp = df.groupby('sensor_type')['megapixels'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_sensor = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, len(sensor_mp)))
bars = ax5.barh(sensor_mp.index, sensor_mp.values, color=colors_sensor, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, sensor_mp.values):
    ax5.text(val + 0.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=10)

# 6. Model Year vs Max ISO (line/scatter)
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df_sorted[df_sorted['brand'] == brand]
    ax6.scatter(brand_data['model_year'], brand_data['max_iso'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], s=150, label=brand, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1, zorder=5)
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Max ISO by Model Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend()
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_yscale('log')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
